text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a non-review research study focused on modeling soil organic carbon changes under different climate and management scenarios in Italy. It does not have a primary focus on land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. Although it uses land use classes as inputs, the central research question is soil carbon dynamics and sequestration potential under compost amendment and climate change, not future LULC prediction. The study does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction and is excluded.)
